title: Physiologically based pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic (PBPK/PD) model of losartan

creators.affiliation: Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin, Faculty of Life Sciences, Department of Biology, Institute of Theoretical Biology, Systems Medicine of the Liver
creators.name: Myshkina, Mariia

creators.affiliation: Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin, Faculty of Life Sciences, Department of Biology, Institute of Theoretical Biology, Systems Medicine of the Liver; University of Stuttgart, Institute of Structural Mechanics and Dynamics in Aerospace Engineering; University of Southern Denmark, Clinical Pharmacology, Pharmacy and Environmental Medicine, Department of Public Health; University Hospital Schleswig-Holstein, Campus Lübeck, First Department of Medicine, Lübeck, Germany

description:
This repository provides the losartan physiologically based pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic (PBPK/PD) model: the oral absorption of losartan, its distribution, its hepatic metabolism to the active metabolite E3174 (CYP2C9) and to inactive metabolites, the renal and biliary excretion of losartan and its metabolites, and the blockade of the AT1 receptor by E3174 with its effects on renin, angiotensin, aldosterone and the blood pressure.
